notes: PBB 2025/26 (July 2025): the ward-coded lines in Table 18 add up to KSh 372,600,000, while the summary (Table 20 'Summary of Development expenditure Details', and the text on p.19) gives ward-based projects as KSh 357,124,313. Checked against the PDF on 24 Oct 2026: every department matches except Roads, Transport and Public Works, whose ward lines in Table 18 add up to KSh 146,500,000 (and, with its flagship lines, to the printed programme totals) but whose ward-based figure in Table 20 is KSh 131,024,313. The KSh 15,475,687 difference is moved to 'Flagship' in Table 20 (190,183,691) without explanation. The vote total (KSh 435,716,791) is the same in both tables. Ward totals on this site use the Table 18 lines.

PBB 2025/26 shows several ward lines at KSh 0 or '-'. This is concentrated in Nyansiongo (ECDE Simbauti, springs, Omosocho motor, Kijauri borehole, 3 boda sheds) and Nyamaiya (borehole, streetlights, health equipping, sports, bee hives, cattle dip). They are kept as 0-amount budgeted records. Nyansiongo's and Nyamaiya's ward-coded totals are therefore unusually low; this does not mean nothing was spent there.

nyamira.go.ke also hosts a second 2025/26 PBB file (24_09_2026_07_30_07_am_PROGRAMME_BASED_BUDGET_2025_26_(1).pdf, 318pp). It is scanned and has no text layer, so it was not compared. It may be a later or approved version.

Ward-attribution conflicts between COB FY2024/25 Table 3.416 and the county ADP 2025/26 roads table (same contractor sums): Nyamatimbo-Egetare-Kiamogake (COB: Bogichora; ADP: Ekerenyo), Nyaramba Jn-Kebabe Girls-Ikonge (COB: Ekerenyo; ADP: Itibo), Outreach Church-Riokerio-...-Bwonchuru (COB: Magombo; ADP: Mekenene). COB records are set to ward=null. ADP records keep the county's own ward coding.

The ADP 2025/26 FY2023/24 roads table showed expenditure KSh 0 'awaiting payment' for several completed roads. COB FY2024/25 later reported Nyamatimbo-Egetare-Kiamogake, Nyaramba-Kebabe-Ikonge and Outreach Church-Riokerio roads as paid in full. Payment status therefore changed after the ADP snapshot.
COB FY2023/24 Table 3.234 lists the Ritongo-Matunwa road and the Ensinyo ECDE twice (rows 5/9 and 8/10). Duplicates were dropped.

Repeat-budgeting candidates seen across documents: Nyachogochogo primary playfield levelling (ward-based 2023/24, spent 998,300, '100% complete') appears again in PBB 2025/26 as 'Completion of levelling of Nyachogochogo Primary Playfield' (Flagship, 1,000,000). Biticha Morera Dispensary OPD (Rigoma): 3.2M budgeted 2023/24, 1.0M in 2024/25, again in PBB 2025/26. Nyakeore twin staff house (Bonyamatuta) and Motagara staff house (Bosamaro) are ongoing contracts and are budgeted again in 2025/26. Omobiro ECDE (Bokeira): 0%/site handed over in FY2023/24, 'termination process' by June 2025, budgeted again in 2025/26. Nyagacho (Mekenene): OPD 3.0M budgeted 2024/25 at 0%, 'Completion of Nyagacho HC' 4.0M in 2025/26.

Status-only lists without KSh amounts were not entered as records: ADP 2025/26 s.2.4.4 ECDE (about 22 centres with ward and % complete) and CADP 2026/27 ECDE status (about 20 centres). The CADP 'Ward Based Projects' annex (pp.210+) and the ADP ward priority lists are wish-lists without amounts.

Rows with location 'Flagship', 'Countywide', 'HQ', 'Nyamira Town', a market or village name we could not map with certainty, or a pair of wards have ward=null and the location text kept. Countywide/flagship amounts were never apportioned to wards.

Kinds: budgeted = an approved or printed budget line or a 'budget allocation' column; contract = contract sum, or a 'Budget Amount' column in a table naming the contractor (flagged in the status text); spent = expenditure or amount paid to date as reported. A few ADP sports figures are 'cumulative expenditure/commitment'. PBB 2024/25 ward-based lists are scattered across department chapters; only the Energy one (p.121) was captured. Its Bogichora 'Electricity installation and connection' amount is garbled ('000,000') and was omitted.
Page references: PBB 2025/26 uses printed 'Page N of 317'. ADP 2025/26 pages are printed page numbers. CADP 2026/27 pages are PDF page indices. COB pages are printed report pages.
